fidelity.reading_rule: Leaves are dicts with mask_px and/or ring_px inside the event payload; camera and role come from their camera/role fields or enclosing mapping keys; operation from payload operation, stage_operation or stage.operation (else no_active_stage). A leaf counts as drawn when its own drawn flag (else ring_px>0) and the event drawn flag (else arm==treatment) hold. Masks arm: inside_mask_pixels_changed is collected at any depth. Point arm: point_cue_pixels_inside_masks is collected at any depth, else the older point-arm name inside_mask_pixels_changed; source_fields counts which name each event used.
fidelity.interpretation: Coverage counts steps per operation and camera on which any outline of that camera was drawn. Gate G5 applies to the masks (treatment) arm only: inside_mask_pixels_changed is 0 wherever reported. The point-arm count of mask pixels covered by the frozen point cue is descriptive and has no requirement. These numbers never alter outcomes, pair eligibility or the registered contrast.

limits: Success time is conditioned on success; it is not a standalone efficiency comparison.
Failures retain terminal elapsed time and control steps, but have null success completion time.
Whole-run elapsed_seconds is never relabeled or substituted for missing task_time_v1.
Hardware, model service placement, and concurrency form an execution cohort; no cross-cohort speedup is claimed.
Six development episodes validate engineering and trace fidelity only; success counts are descriptive.
No prospective success-rate improvement, statistical significance, generalization or leaderboard claim.
All six complete valid traces and paired initial conditions are required for gate G9; task failures may pass engineering checks.
Pixel geometry, crop fidelity, full array hashes, GPU renderer identity and cleanup require their separate gates.
This analysis neither performs a seed audit nor freezes a formal prospective experiment.
